# Tuteliq Kotlin SDK

> Official Kotlin SDK for Tuteliq, the child safety API, for Android and JVM applications.

## What is this?
A Kotlin library for the Tuteliq child safety API. Detect bullying, grooming, self-harm, fraud, synthetic content and other harms in text, images, voice, video and documents; run age and identity verification sessions; and work the incident queue. Requires Java 17+.

## Install
// build.gradle.kts
dependencies {
    implementation("ai.tuteliq:tuteliq:2.5.0")
}

## Quick Start
import ai.tuteliq.*
val client = Tuteliq(apiKey = System.getenv("TUTELIQ_API_KEY"))
val result = client.detectUnsafe(content = "content to check", context = AnalysisContext(ageGroup = "13-15"))

## Key Features
- Kotlin coroutines (suspend functions), Ktor-based HTTP client
- Text, image, voice, video and document (PDF or image) analysis
- Fraud and extended safety detection, multi-endpoint analysis, synthetic content detection, nickname review
- Verification sessions: createVerificationSession, getVerificationSession, cancelVerificationSession
- Incidents: listIncidents, getIncident, getIncidentsOverview, getIncidentTrends, reviewIncident, batchReviewIncidents
- Privacy redaction, webhooks, usage and quota, GDPR account tools
- Age group calibration

## Supported Languages
32 languages: English (stable); Spanish, Portuguese, Ukrainian, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German, French, Dutch, Polish, Italian, Turkish, Romanian, Greek, Czech, Hungarian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Slovak, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Slovenian, Maltese, Irish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian (beta). Auto-detected, no configuration needed.
